exposure: Transvaginal ultrasonographic (TVS) cervical assessment (cervical length, funneling, position of cervix, and distance of presenting part from external os)
cohort: 131 pregnant women at term with intact membranes and live fetus undergoing labor induction
finding: In women undergoing labour induction, transvaginal ultrasound score, including cervical length, funneling, position of cervix, and distance of presenting part from external os, was a better indicator of successful induction compared to Bishop Score.
